title: REFUNDABLE COMBO CART
description: Card shops now let players test a paid combo bundle in a tiny practice hand, then refund it once if the synergy collapses like a tutorial written by committee.
consequence: The shop lets the receipt touch grass first.

title: HONEST INSURANCE RECEIPT
description: Gear insurance now lists exactly which backpack slots, cursed trinkets, suspicious keys, and emotionally expensive helmets it will actually bring home.
consequence: The backpack stops buying umbrellas for rocks.

title: PRE-CHECKED COMFORT BASKET
description: Decoration plans now arrive with recommended trims, matching lamps, premium rug cousins, and one tasteful little checkbox already nodding like it pays rent.
consequence: The rug learns to invite its relatives.

title: VILLAGE SCRIP WALLET
description: Camp vendors now split purchases across local scrip, favor chits, rain tokens, and emergency plank credit so every trade feels more grounded and less believable.
consequence: The wallet becomes a side quest nobody trusts.
